content:
Formula: First Law of Thermodynamics
Exact Expression: dU = \delta Q - \delta W
Definitions: Law of conservation of energy for thermodynamic systems stating that the change in internal energy equals heat supplied minus work done.
Derivation/Reference: Julius Robert von Mayer (1842); James Prescott Joule (1843); Rudolf Clausius (1850)
Example: Isochoric process (constant volume dV = 0): dW = 0 -> dU = dQ = C_v dT
Domain: thermodynamics
Assumptions: Closed system interacting thermally and mechanically with surroundings
Common Errors: Treating heat Q and work W as state functions instead of path-dependent process quantities
subject: First Law of Thermodynamics
